name: Motorcycle Simulator Oregon
summary:
Ride Portland, Oregon, from the seat - alone or with your friends.

39 KM ROUND PORTLAND
Down the Banfield to the Rose Quarter past the Moda Center and the Convention Center spires, north on I-5 with the downtown towers across the Willamette, over the Columbia on the Interstate Bridge, east along the Vancouver waterfront, then high over the river on the Glenn Jackson Bridge and down I-205 past PDX.

RIDE IT LIKE A REAL BIKE
Grip the bars with your own hands. Roll your right wrist to open the throttle, brake
